notes.title: Content Update 1.2 is Now Released!
notes.content:
Hi, it's James! Its been about a month since Wizard Survivors released. First I'd like to thank all of you for playing and giving your feedback! It was all really valuable and really helped improve the game.

This is the first of many free content updates for WS! Since release, I've been working on new content for the game - mainly the new character, the [b]Necromancer[/b]. Raise undead skeleton soldiers to fight for you and manipulate your life in exchange for power! I'm happy with how she turned out and hope you enjoy unlocking and playing her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152461/73a869796fe51502f87922a3b815aeb5a531ea1b.png[/img]

As well as that, there are several randomly generated structures that generate in your world to vary up the forest! More structures/other world generation improvements are planned for future updates too!
The final major change is the addition of achievements! There are 17 in total for you to get so far but more are planned to be added in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152461/e39806eb584883e0aead7dd581ba66735ad01a8e.png[/img]

New Content:
- New character: Necromancer
- New generated Structures added to world generation
- Achievements!

Misc/Changes
- Added cloud save support
- Removed health penalty from some items
- Tweaked knockback

Bugfixes:
- Improved accuracy of ice elemental
- Fixed unlock popup size being too small
- Misc visual bugs
